gaps: Single sign-on: the browser app acting as a broker for other apps, with the shell routing callbacks through CallbackRoutes.
Web authentication session: a shell-run sign-in sheet that opens the page in an isolated session; the callback routing part is modelled by CallbackRoutes, but nothing presents the page yet.
Passkeys and FIDO2: a platform authenticator, public-key credential registration and assertion, and WebAuthn support in the browser (springboard/apps/browser/README.md lists WebAuthn as broken).
Shared credential store and AutoFill: keychain access groups (shared items between apps), a save-password prompt, and a credential provider for the browser and other apps.
One-time passcodes: capture and suggestion of verification codes delivered to the device.
Credential import and export: Apple's CXF format for interop, passkeys and notes in the document, and a UI import or export action.
Keychain access control: biometric or user-presence protection of items (already listed as a parity gap in docs/bifrost-ui.md, Keychain section).
